title: AI Ad Image Generator | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a square Facebook or Instagram ad photo from one product shot with clear space left for your headline or offer, added in Ads Manager or Canva.
h1: AI Ad Image Generator for Facebook and Instagram
lead: A feed ad has to make the product clear at thumbnail size and still leave room for your headline, but paying a designer for each new version adds up fast. Make the square ad photo from one product shot with the open space built in, then type and test every word in your ad tool.
secondary_keywords: square ad images for social media
AI images for paid social ads
benefits_h2: Why make social ad photos with AI?

benefits.t: The product reads at thumbnail size
benefits.d: One clear item in a simple scene stays recognizable while people scroll, which busy designs lose in a feed.
Ask for an open side or upper area, so your offer fits without covering the product or crowding the frame.
The photo ships without baked-in text; you type the headline and price in Ads Manager or Canva, where spelling is exact.

benefits.t: Test several scenes from one photo
benefits.d: Generate alternative backdrops or one-use moments with the same audience and offer, each with its credit cost shown first.

steps_h2: How to make a square social ad photo in 3 simple steps
steps_lead: Three steps turn one product photo into a square ad image with headline space, ready for Ads Manager.

steps.d: Upload one clear, in-focus product photo. The item has to read instantly when the ad appears at thumbnail size.

steps.t: Describe the Scene and Text Space
steps.d: Choose one backdrop or setting and say where the headline goes, such as open space on the left. Simple scenes scroll better.
Download the photo, then type your offer and price in Ads Manager or Canva. Preview it on a phone before launch.

faq.q: Can the AI put my headline and price on the image?
faq.a: No. It creates the product scene with open space but does not render readable campaign text. Compare [macro detail photos](/ai-image-generation/macro-details) when a small product feature must stay visible.

faq.q: What size are the ad images?
faq.a: The examples on this page use square feed images. Other placements may use different dimensions or crops. For placement planning, use [TikTok ads](/platforms/tiktok-ads) and [product video demos](/ai-video-generation/product-video) alongside this square frame.

faq.q: Can I test two scene options?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the audience and offer consistent so the scene is the main change between versions. For a fair test, pair this tool with [UGC ad videos](/ai-video-generation/ugc-ad-video) and [the AI UGC video ads guide](/blog/ai-ugc-video-ads-guide).

faq.q: Do I have to say my ad image was made with AI?
faq.a: Disclosure rules vary by platform, location and use. Follow the guidance shown in the ad tool for your campaign. For product detail coverage, see [story ad images](/ai-image-generation/story-ad-vertical) and [size reference images](/ai-image-generation/size-reference).

faq.q: What makes a social product photo clear?
faq.a: Keep the product recognizable, in focus and engaged in one believable everyday action. For apparel campaigns, compare [fashion and clothing ideas](/industries/fashion-clothing) and [fashion editorial photos](/ai-image-generation/fashion-editorial). Check the crop at phone width, keep the main object separated from nearby props, and compare the final thumbnail with the product page before you publish.

faq.q: Can I use an outdoor scene?
faq.a: Yes. Describe a simple outdoor use moment while keeping the product shape and color consistent. For seasonal campaigns, review [Black Friday campaigns](/occasions/black-friday) and [product launch campaigns](/occasions/product-launch).

faq.q: Can I upload the photo straight into a live ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use, so after you add approved text you can place the image directly into a Facebook or Instagram ad. Check the placement crop and safe areas in Ads Manager before the campaign goes live.

faq.q: How do I add a price badge without making the ad look fake?
faq.a: Add it in your ad tool or Canva after download rather than asking the image to render it. AI lettering can misspell numbers, while an overlay stays sharp, matches your real offer and is easy to change between tests.

overview.d: Square product visuals give a feed concept a clear focal point while people scroll. Start with one product photo, choose one scene and leave part of the frame open. Product claims and offers come from your approved campaign details. Plan the rest of the campaign with [white background photos](/ai-image-generation/ecommerce-main-image), [lifestyle photos](/ai-image-generation/lifestyle-scene), [model photos](/ai-image-generation/on-model-generation), [sale campaign visuals](/ai-image-generation/sale-campaign-key-visual), [UGC still ads](/ai-image-generation/ugc-still-ad), [packshot angles](/ai-image-generation/packshot-multi-angle), [color variation photos](/ai-image-generation/colorway-variations), [Instagram ads](/platforms/instagram-ads), [Facebook ads](/platforms/facebook-ads), [the ad sizes guide](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), [the testing ad versions guide](/guides/testing-ad-versions), and [the inspiration gallery](/inspiration).

limitations.h2: Features for a square ad photo

items.d: Keep one item recognizable at thumbnail size so the feed concept has a clear focal point.
Describe an open side or upper area where your approved headline can be added later.
Use a hand, try-on or first-bite moment to make the product benefit visible.
Price, promotion dates and discount terms come from your approved campaign; add them after download.
Preview each placement because your ad tool determines the final dimensions and crop.
